title: The AI stack in UK exports
source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics; ONS UK trade in goods by CPA (MQ10); ONS trade in services (QNA); ukmacro calculations
note: Upper bound: whole product groups, which contain AI and non-AI products (ONS has not yet published AI shares). Layers nest from narrowest to broadest: the IMF hardware basket and other AI products (HMRC, by commodity code) are inside the ONS extended goods tier (CPA 26-28, MQ10), and the grey layer is the rest of that tier. AI services = ONS core services tier (QNA). Other AI products exclude codes created in 2022 (sensors, handling robots, drones).
